 Malsalami, Dist. - Patna At present House of Savitri Devi, W/o - Late  Rajendra Prasad, Mohalla - Naya Gaon, P.S. - Alamganj, Dist. - Patna  ... ... Opposite Party/s

======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Abhay Kumar, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Md. Matloob Rab, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ASHUTOSH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 7 04-10-2024 Heard Mr. Abhay Kumar, learned Advocate for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner, who is the husband of opposite party no. 2, seeks bail in anticipation of his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 945 of 2019 in which cognizance has been taken under Sections 406, 379, 403, 323, 504 and 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3.
The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that there is every possibility of settlement of dispute.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.24765 of 2024(7) dt.04-10-2024 4.

Let notice be issued to the opposite party no. 2 under registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process subject to steps being taken by the petitioner within a period of two weeks from today, returnable on 06.12.2024.
